t: The Verve Gardening Gloves are heavy-duty leather work gloves designed to protect hands during tough outdoor tasks. These unlined olive green gloves provide a barrier against thorns, brambles, and sharp objects, making them ideal for professional landscapers and gardeners. Featuring a straight thumb design and an open cuff for quick removal, they offer a dexterity level of 3 to allow precise control over hand tools. The breathable leather fabric ensures comfort during extended use, while abrasion and puncture resistance ratings deliver long-lasting durability for daily trade gardening and clearance work.
b: Level 3 Dexterity Allows Precise Tool Control
Leather Shell Protects against Thorns & Sharp Brambles
Hand Washable Leather Simplifies Maintenance & Care
Unisex Sizing Ensures Comfortable Fit for Men & Women
